headline: A closer look at aerospace.
prompt: Use case: ads-marketing / editorial ad redesign. Edit the provided Instagram advertisement into a more native Instagram FEED creative. Keep its natural photographic subject and believable material detail. Remove the entire large cream text panel, all large typography and bottom rules. Extend/reframe the photograph to fill the ENTIRE portrait 4:5 canvas, ideally 1440x1800. Keep the photographed aircraft or components as the main subject with more natural visual breathing room, and preserve correct plausible geometry. The result must feel like a real industrial brand's social photograph, not a brochure, poster, glossy CGI render, or fake UI screenshot. Natural available daylight, neutral color grading, genuine-looking minor surface wear, no dramatic flare, no floating objects. No Instagram interface, no buttons, no invented logos or aircraft liveries. Add only a small understated text lockup 'SAIF INDUSTRIES' near the upper left with one short line beneath it using the exact headline specified, clean small sans serif in white with subtle shadow if needed, no solid banner. Tiny legible disclosure 'AI CONCEPT / STUDENT PROJECT' at bottom left. Text must occupy under 8% of the image. Do not imply this is an actual photograph of SAIF's inventory or aircraft. Preserve the brand's forest-green note in the natural scene rather than a heavy green filter. Headline: 'A closer look at aerospace.'.
